formats.name: Taxonomy diagram
formats.summary: The selected Surnex Venn diagram arranges competitive games within overlapping Micro, Meso and Macro regions so a cross-genre classification can be inspected and debated.
formats.cross_game: A diagram can make relationships portable across communities, but its clear boundaries can appear more settled than the situated and disputed judgements behind them.

formats.name: Frame data
formats.summary: The selected Dustloop table turns move timing into aligned values that can be compared and used to reason about punish windows.
formats.cross_game: Timed comparison recurs across action-oriented games, but this exact numerical grammar depends on what an engine and community choose to expose.

formats.name: Build order
formats.summary: The selected Spawning Tool page externalises a StarCraft II opening as a timed sequence of structures, units and actions.
formats.cross_game: Ordered plans resemble opening theory across strategy games, while their apparent script cannot show how much situated play must depart from the plan.

formats.name: Callout map
formats.summary: The selected Total CS Mirage map labels locations so a team can share a compact spatial vocabulary.
formats.cross_game: Named locations travel across team-based spatial games, but a fixed map cannot show when, why or how a position matters during play.
